sentinels.purpose: ZERO GOVERNED READS AND ZERO PACMI CALLS in the executor-hardening lane. The only git executions are local (.invalid host, config listing); no gh or vercel process is spawned by any test.
NO CREDENTIAL-SHAPED LITERAL IN THE REPOSITORY. Test fixtures assemble token- and hook-shaped strings at runtime; the supplemental scanner over the committed write set must stay clean.
ALLOWLIST, NOT DENYLIST. A method guard that only enumerates forbidden flags is incomplete by construction; the operative control is exact-shape equality of the whole argv.
NON-VACUITY. Every 'runner never called' assertion is paired with a positive control proving the same fake runner is installed and reachable.

positive_controls.description: A registry op reaches the runner with the exact GET argv and yields a validated evidence record.
V-R1 projection keeps deploy-hook metadata, presence booleans and the autodeploy locus, and drops the hook URL, the password and env values.
PACMI-G1 drops a token field from gh output; PACMI-V3 keeps only the executor's own member row.
The terminating protocol runs RC-9a first, DN-0 last before reads, G-R1 before G-R2, never V-R4, never targets uellix-antigravity in role limbs, issues no git commit, and its bundle scans clean.
A certification-event file ADDED after certification is accepted by DN-0.
Real git: the XCC-1 environment passes the static guard, its preflight lists only the three command-line resets, and credential fill produces no credential even with a hostile core.askPass.
The supplemental scanner has a detector for every class secrets:scan is blind to, and does not flag SHAs, Vercel ids or alias hostnames.

negative_controls.description: GitHub implicit POST via -f / --raw-field / -F / --field is refused before execution.
GitHub explicit POST (--method POST, -X POST, --method=DELETE) is refused before execution.
GitHub without an explicit --method is refused (gh's default is not relied upon); --verbose, -i, -H, --hostname, --show-token and a GH_TOKEN override are refused.
Vercel -f body semantics, --raw-field, -F, --input are refused before execution.
Vercel write operation id (deleteProject) as the endpoint is refused before execution.
Vercel non-GET method, missing --method, --generate=curl, --verbose, --dangerously-skip-permissions, --scope and decrypt=true are refused before execution.
An arbitrary endpoint (off-registry op id, or a registry op whose built path is mutated) is refused before execution.
Raw response persistence: a bypassed projector is refused by conformance, and a raw object is never a validated record.
Deploy-hook URL output is refused even when it arrives through an allowlisted field.
Env-value output: L5 drops value, and a bypassed projector carrying it is refused.
G-R2 before G-R1 is refused; G-R2 after a G-R1 without a permission object is refused (RC-9b).
RNA-1: every role limb (L1/L3/L5/L7) against uellix-antigravity is refused, and role limbs before a complete inventory are refused.
V-R4 is refused in the read-only phase.

X-R1 with the credential helper still active, a credential-bearing URL, an ssh or http URL, askpass available (set or unset GIT_ASKPASS, SSH_ASKPASS), extraHeader injected through the environment, ceiling removed, system config re-enabled, or cwd outside the root is refused by the static guard.

Real git: each askpass vector is shown LIVE (returns a password) and then refused; a file-provided helper, extraHeader, insteadOf, or a parent repository's config is shown visible to the preflight and refused; a helper SUBSTITUTED for the missing reset (same key names) is refused by the origin check.

Protocol: HEAD moving after DN-0, a post-certification MODIFY, a FAIL certification verdict, or an unestablished Vercel role are each refused; the evidence commit must have parent == DN-0 HEAD and only add evidence.
The supplemental scanner fails on an empty file set and never echoes the matched text.
